question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Done for
solution: The correct answer is **"Ruined."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom** "done for"** means to be ruined or destroyed. (नष्ट होना) • **Example**: *The company's reputation was **done for**__ after the scandal.* • It can refer to a person, thing, or situation that has suffered irreparable damage or harm. • The idiom is often used in a negative context to describe a dire or hopeless situation. • **"Ruined"** means to damage something so badly that it loses all its value, pleasure, etc. (किसी चीज़ को तबाह कर देना, बरबाद कर देना (कि वह बिलकुल बेकार हो जाए)) __ • **Example**: *This is a **ruined**__ building.* The correct answer is **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (Retreated)** means to withdraw or move back, often in the face of danger or opposition. (अक्सर खतरे या विरोध की स्थिति में पीछे हटना या पीछे हटना) • **Option 2 (Depreciated)** means to decrease in value or worth over time. (समय के साथ मूल्य या कीमत में कमी आना) • **Option 3 (Finished a job)** means to complete a task or assignment. (किसी कार्य या असाइनमेंट को पूरा करना) 4b:T6b3, The correct answer is **"cannot be compared with."**
